questions.question: In the context of Introduction to Organometallic Compounds, what is the major organic product when Cyclohex-2-en-1-one + (CH₃)₂CuLi reacts under the following conditions: 1. Et₂O at -78°C  2. H₃O⁺?
questions.explanation: Major product rationale: Soft organocuprate (Gilman) reagents add selectively to the β-position of α,β-unsaturated ketones. The correct major product is '3-Methylcyclohexanone (1,4-Conjugate adduct)'.

questions.question: In the context of Introduction to Organometallic Compounds, what is the major organic product when 1-Bromooctane + (CH₃)₂CuLi reacts under the following conditions: Anhydrous Et₂O at 0°C?
questions.explanation: Major product rationale: Corey-House coupling of lithium dialkylcuprate with primary alkyl halide forms a new C-C bond cleanly. The correct major product is 'Nonane (CH₃(CH₂)₇CH₃) + CH₃Cu + LiBr'.

questions.question: In the context of Introduction to Organometallic Compounds, what is the major organic product when Cyclohexene reacts under the following conditions: CH₂I₂ + Zn(Cu) in dry Et₂O?
questions.explanation: Major product rationale: Zinc carbenoid transfers a methylene (:CH₂) unit stereospecifically syn across the double bond without free carbene. The correct major product is 'Bicyclo[4.1.0]heptane (Norcarane)'.

questions.question: In the context of Introduction to Organometallic Compounds, what is the major organic product when cis-2-Butene reacts under the following conditions: CHCl₃ + t-BuOK in pentane?
questions.explanation: Major product rationale: Alpha-elimination generates dichlorocarbene (:CCl₂), which adds with complete retention of cis stereochemistry. The correct major product is 'cis-1,1-Dichloro-2,3-dimethylcyclopropane'.

questions.question: In the context of Introduction to Organometallic Compounds, what is the major organic product when Bromobenzene + Phenylboronic acid [PhB(OH)₂] reacts under the following conditions: cat. Pd(PPh₃)₄, 2M Na₂CO₃ in toluene, 90°C?
questions.explanation: Major product rationale: Palladium-catalyzed cross-coupling of aryl halide with arylboronic acid in the presence of base. The correct major product is 'Biphenyl (Ph-Ph) + B(OH)₃ + NaBr'.
